topic: Google AI Studio Gemini API Free Tier (per-project quota & privacy caveat)
caption:
Save this before making 5 Google AI Studio keys for higher limits.

If you're using the Gemini API free tier instead of paid free AI tools for developers, remember Google counts RPM, TPM, and daily calls per Cloud project, not per key. Extra keys inside one project share the exact same bucket.

Quotas reset at midnight Pacific Time. Don't paste client secrets on the free tier either, since Google may review free prompts for training.
